title: Walrus artwork on Epstein's wall

tellings.quote:
And on the wall there was a big artwork
of a a woman being raped by a walrus.

plain: In 2002, on a wall at a property of Jeffrey Epstein, there was said to hang a large artwork showing a woman being raped by a walrus. The researcher Jay Anderson tells Michels this, passing on what a witness named Juliet Byron told him she saw. Anderson raises it as a sign of the dark tastes of Epstein's world.
